title: Daily digest: Enemy's enemy friend? DMK mouthpiece amp | State Govt Accords High Priority to SCs, | US deports Khalistan supporter linked to | Dalits in Gorakhpur face more injustice
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: India Today / Deccan Chronicle / Times of India / The Hindu
bullets_en: Enemy's enemy friend? DMK mouthpiece amplifies BJP chief's attack on Vijay.
State Govt Accords High Priority to SCs, STs, Says Revanth.
US deports Khalistan supporter linked to Punjab railway blast, held in Delhi.
Dalits in Gorakhpur face more injustice than anywhere else, alleges Akhilesh.
bullets_ur: Dushman ka dushman dost? DMK tarjuman ne Vijay par BJP chief ki tanqeed ko mazeed hawa di.
Subai hukumat SCs aur STs ko aala tarjeeh deti hai, Revanth ka bayan.
US ne Punjab railway blast se juray Khalistan supporter ko deport kiya, Delhi mein girafthaar.
Gorakhpur mein Dalits ko sab se zyada na-insafi ka samna hai, Akhilesh ka ilzam.
